verses.1: May David be delivered by Yahweh! How shall I say to my soul, “You are safe”?
verses.2: For behold, the wicked will walk on a path of destruction; they will build barriers against those who are righteous.
verses.3: For those who drink wine will be destroyed, even the righteous ones.
verses.4: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is in heaven, as a throne. His eyes see everything; His followers are children of man.
verses.5: The LORD is righteous; He rewards the good and hates the wicked. He loves those who are faithful, but hates those who are unfaithful.
verses.6: May fire and sulfur be poured upon the wicked. May they be tormented by a storm of flames and wind.
verses.7: For the LORD is righteous; His judgments are just. He loves those who are righteous and will bless them.
